name: Future funk
summary: Cels and stills from 1980s and 1990s anime in warm sunset colours, with city and neon signs and bright pastel type. It adds the sample-based look of vaporwave to upbeat dance music and Japanese pop culture.

philosophy.core_thesis: Take the dreamy irony of vaporwave and make it warm and danceable: the past of Japanese pop and anime is a place to enjoy, not only to mourn.
design_principles: Use a cropped still from a 1980s or 1990s anime as the focal image; run it at 60% to 80% of the viewport width.
Set a sunset gradient from hot pink (#FF6FB5) through peach (#FFB48A) to teal (#3CD7C9) at 160° behind the still.
Add a halftone or dot screen of 6px to 10px at 10% to 15% opacity over the gradient.
Set headlines in a rounded bold sans-serif, with a Japanese line at 50% of the size under each heading.
Frame content in rounded cards with a 3px white edge and a flat pink shadow of 6px.
Use a deep indigo ground (#1B1F4B) for text areas and keep body text at 16px with a contrast of 7:1 or more.
Add small stars, hearts and city silhouettes as flat shapes at 8% to 15% of the layout.
anti_patterns: Dense dark layouts with no colour

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid with 24px gutters; a large still spans 7 columns and cards overlap its edge by 16px to 32px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 15% to 25% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24 and 48px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred hero and flush-left cards; stickers and stars float at offsets of 8px to 24px.
layout.container_geometry: Cards with a 20px radius and a 3px white edge; circles and pills for tags; flat offset shadows.

font_pairings.note: A rounded Japanese-style display face with a soft text face.
A bold, friendly round face for a playful tone.
A heavy gothic display face with a plain Japanese text face.

typography.tracking: Display takes 0.02em; tags take 0.1em; body stays at 0.01em.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and extra bold (800).
Add a katakana or kanji line under each main heading.

color.palette_structure: A warm sunset set of pink, peach and teal on deep indigo, with a pale cream for panels.
color.contrast_rules: Text on night indigo holds at least 7:1; pink, peach and teal carry headings, edges and shapes, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: Smooth sunset gradients with a halftone screen; flat colour for cards; cel-style flat fills in stills.
color.light_and_shadow: Flat offset shadows of 6px in pink; a soft glow of 6px on signs; no realistic cast shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: Anime cel and print: flat fills, hard outlines, film grain and a faint CRT or tape softness.
materiality.border_rules: A 3px white edge on cards; a 2px indigo line on tags.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Glow of 6px on neon signs only; cards have a 6px flat offset shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Rounded filled icons at 24px with a thick body and round ends, in white or pink.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Stills and cels from 1980s and 1990s anime, city skylines at dusk, stars and hearts, and a few katakana signs.

motion.transition_physics: Bouncy and upbeat: cards slide in with a 10% overshoot; the still pans by 3% in 12s; stars pulse at 2s.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts the card by 4px and widens the shadow to 10px; active state moves the card down by 2px.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels warm, playful nostalgia and wants to dance.

avoid_when: The audience is formal or conservative.
The page needs a serious, neutral tone.
The brand has no link to anime or Japanese pop culture.

modifiers.how: Swap the anime still for a classical bust; use violet and cyan on a dark purple ground and add a perspective floor.
Swap the anime still for a faded photo of an empty mall; use peach and teal with tile floors.
Replace the cels with glossy 3D renders; use sky blue and white and drop the halftone.

pack.why: Filled icons with round shapes match the soft, bold look of the cels and stickers.

ground.why: Future funk keeps the screen-printed dot of anime posters under a sunset gradient.

tailwind.classes: rounded-[20px] border border-[#3CD7C9] bg-[#FF6FB5] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[#1B1F4B]
